meta.title: Great Works
meta.scope: Civ6 fixed named Great Works: works of Writers, Artists, Musicians, Sun Tzu; 24 standard Relics. Excludes artifacts, products, Heroic Relics, Relics of the Void and scenarios.
meta.eraPolicy: In-game era of creator, not historical creation date; relics Unassigned after Information Era.
meta.mapPolicy: Two coordinate sets: creationCoords for documented composition/creation place; currentCoords for surviving unique physical original, collection or traditionally associated relic. Unknown and not-applicable coordinates null. Generic place of publication or creator birthplace never substituted as creation place.
meta.datePolicy: createdYear numeric for approximate chronological sorting; createdYearLabel notes dates/intervals, including publication or premiere when the precise composition date is not available. Unknown dates sort last. BCE negative without year zero.
meta.locationPolicy: Modern country names; historical site names where appropriate. Current location may be Unknown, Not applicable, Multiple originals, Multiple impressions, or traditionally associated custody. All locations subject to verification.
meta.qualityNote: Curated preliminary historic metadata. In-game roster/type verified; historical creation dates, attribution and custody are not exhaustively verified; unknown data intentionally omitted rather than inferred. Source links provided for follow-up.
meta.images: Not collected. No thumbnail files required.
